thread:
diego (support): @maya thanks for the ping — opening thread for the Billing/API-key 403 you reported after the IdP change. Can you paste the exact error text and any trace/request ids?
maya (ACME): repro steps: 1) SSO login -> 2) switch org to "ACME Corp" -> 3) click Billing -> 403. Also trying Console > API keys -> Create API key -> 403. Error text: \"You do not have permission to view this page (403)\". Trace shown in console: trace=acme-7f1b2c3d. I appear as Org Owner in the members list. :grimacing:
liz (eng-sre): that trace id helps, thanks. Quick questions: is this happening for all users in the org or just @maya? Also, are they using the browser SSO session or an exchange to get a delegated token?
maya (ACME): I tested with 2 other admins — they see the same. We're all using Okta SSO (browser sessions). No delegated CLI tokens involved.
tess (support): I tried to repro from my end using an Okta test account mapped to the same groups. I hit 403 when trying to open Billing too. Grabbed network log; server responded with 403 and header X-Request-Id: r-0a1b2c3d.
---

auth-bot: authz check: request=r-0a1b2c3d, decision=DENY, reason=\"missing_project_write_scope_for-billing\", claims_sub=okta|12345, delegated_session=false
---

liz (eng-sre): auth-bot shows delegated_session=false which is suspicious — the new IdP flow should set delegated=true for browser SSO exchange. Can you check cookie/session subject on the client (F12 -> Application -> Cookies) and paste the `session.claims` payload (only the claim names/values, obfuscate PII)?
maya (ACME): pasted minimal: { groups: ["acme-admins"], role: "org_owner", delegated: "false", aud: "console" }. I thought delegated would be true after we flipped the new exchange.
diego (support): that explains the deny: our console routing requires delegated=true for billing and API key actions (safety gate) on this rollout. If the session claim is false, we intentionally block mutation actions. Looks like Okta mapping didn't set the delegated flag for sessions from this customer.
liz (eng-sre): short repro curl that mirrors the console call (use the SSO session cookie):
```bash
curl -v "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/orgs/12345/billing" \
  -H "Cookie: session=<<their_session_cookie>>" \
  -H "Accept: application/json"
```
Response: 403 + JSON {"error":"forbidden","reason":"missing_project_write_scope_for-billing","trace":"r-0a1b2c3d"}
---

tess (support): immediate mitigation for customer: 1) create a temporary org admin API key via admin CLI (we can escalate to create one server-side) OR 2) re-invite the affected admins via email so they get a fresh session (force new session.claims mapping). Which do you want us to do @maya?
maya (ACME): we need Billing access now to download invoices. Please provide temporary path. Re-invite will take longer.
diego (support): ok we'll issue a temporary admin API key scoped to billing read only. @liz can you approve a short-lived key creation for org 12345? Include audit tag `support:1798881234-temp-key`.
liz (eng-sre): approved. Creating key now and adding audit note. Key created: starts with rwd_sk_temp_xxx (I've DM'ed the full key to @maya). We should still fix the root cause with IdP mapping.
---

liz (eng-sre): root cause analysis so far: Okta SCIM/group claim mapping for this customer did not set the `delegated` boolean on sessions after the IdP exchange rollback/rollout. Our policy gate checks delegated===true for billing/mutation routes; mismatch leads to 403. We need to push a mapping fix + a small tolerance change in the console to accept `role:org_owner` for Billing read-only while mapping is corrected. I'll file eng ticket and attach traces.
---

diego (support): next steps for support: 1) sent temp key (done), 2) confirm customer can download invoices and create API keys if needed (maya please confirm), 3) eng will deploy mapping patch and small console tolerance change, 4) we'll rotate the temp key once mapping is fixed.
maya (ACME): confirmed — invoice download succeeded with temp key, thanks. Please ETA on permanent fix?
liz (eng-sre): creating ENG-5472 (IdP session delegated flag mapping bug) and DEPLOY-FASTM-231 (console permissive fallback for invoices). ETA: patch + canary in 24–48h, full rollout 72h after verification.
tess (support): I'll follow up with a support ticket and send post-mortem to the account thread with timeline. Closing this Slack thread once eng marks ticket in progress. :white_check_mark:
